cards.front: Three pens cost Rp 4.500 each. What is the total?
cards.say: Three pens cost four thousand five hundred rupiah each. What is the total? Thirteen thousand five hundred rupiah. Three times four thousand five hundred equals thirteen thousand five hundred.

cards.front: You pay Rp 50.000 for goods that cost Rp 37.500. What is your change?
cards.say: You pay fifty thousand rupiah for goods that cost thirty seven thousand five hundred rupiah. What is your change? Twelve thousand five hundred rupiah
Twelve thousand five hundred rupiah plus eight thousand seven hundred and fifty rupiah equals what? Twenty one thousand two hundred and fifty rupiah

cards.front: Rp 100.000 take away Rp 64.000 = ?
cards.say: One hundred thousand rupiah take away sixty four thousand rupiah equals what? Thirty six thousand rupiah

cards.front: Rp 25.000 is shared equally among 5 children. How much does each get?
cards.say: Twenty five thousand rupiah is shared equally among five children. How much does each get? Five thousand rupiah

cards.front: A cake costs Rp 2.500. How much do 6 cakes cost?
cards.say: A cake costs two thousand five hundred rupiah. How much do six cakes cost? Fifteen thousand rupiah

cards.front: Round Rp 14.670 to the nearest Rp 1.000.
cards.back:
Rp 15.000
The hundreds digit is 6, so round up.
cards.say: Round fourteen thousand six hundred and seventy rupiah to the nearest one thousand rupiah. Fifteen thousand rupiah. The hundreds digit is six, so round up.

cards.front: Estimate Rp 19.800 + Rp 30.200 by rounding to the nearest Rp 1.000.
cards.say: Estimate nineteen thousand eight hundred plus thirty thousand two hundred rupiah, rounding to the nearest thousand. About fifty thousand rupiah. Twenty thousand plus thirty thousand.

cards.front: What is half of Rp 18.000?
cards.say: What is half of eighteen thousand rupiah? Nine thousand rupiah

cards.front: What is a quarter of Rp 40.000?
cards.say: What is a quarter of forty thousand rupiah? Ten thousand rupiah

cards.front: What is Rp 1.000 more than Rp 9.500?
cards.say: What is one thousand rupiah more than nine thousand five hundred rupiah? Ten thousand five hundred rupiah

cards.front: Wati saves Rp 5.000 each week. How much does she save in 8 weeks?
cards.say: Wati saves five thousand rupiah each week. How much does she save in eight weeks? Forty thousand rupiah

cards.front: Rp 75.000 take away Rp 28.500 = ?
cards.say: Seventy five thousand rupiah take away twenty eight thousand five hundred rupiah equals what? Forty six thousand five hundred rupiah

cards.front: A book costs Rp 35.000 and a bag costs Rp 65.000. What is the total?
cards.say: A book costs thirty five thousand rupiah and a bag costs sixty five thousand rupiah. What is the total? One hundred thousand rupiah

cards.front: 3 mangoes cost Rp 9.000, or 1 mango costs Rp 3.500. Which is the better price per mango?
cards.back:
3 for Rp 9.000
That is Rp 3.000 each. Three at Rp 3.500 would cost Rp 10.500.
cards.say: Three mangoes cost nine thousand rupiah, or one mango costs three thousand five hundred rupiah. Which is the better price per mango? Three for nine thousand rupiah

cards.front: Items cost Rp 6.500 and Rp 7.250. You pay Rp 20.000. What is your change?
cards.say: Items cost six thousand five hundred rupiah and seven thousand two hundred and fifty rupiah. You pay twenty thousand rupiah. What is your change? Six thousand two hundred and fifty rupiah

cards.front: How many Rp 5.000 notes make Rp 45.000?
cards.say: How many five thousand rupiah notes make forty five thousand rupiah? Nine notes

cards.front: Rp 150.000 is shared equally among 3 people. How much does each get?
cards.say: One hundred and fifty thousand rupiah is shared equally among three people. How much does each get? Fifty thousand rupiah

cards.front: How many Rp 500 coins make Rp 7.000?
cards.say: How many five hundred rupiah coins make seven thousand rupiah? Fourteen coins. Seven thousand divided by five hundred equals fourteen.
Three thousand two hundred and fifty rupiah plus three thousand two hundred and fifty rupiah plus three thousand two hundred and fifty rupiah equals what? Nine thousand seven hundred and fifty rupiah

cards.front: How many Rp 100.000 notes make Rp 1.000,000?
cards.say: How many one hundred thousand rupiah notes make one million rupiah? Ten notes

cards.front: Rp 48.000 is shared equally among 6 children. How much does each get?
cards.say: Forty eight thousand rupiah is shared equally among six children. How much does each get? Eight thousand rupiah

cards.front: 2 drinks cost Rp 6.500 each and a snack costs Rp 4.000. What is the total?
cards.say: Two drinks cost six thousand five hundred rupiah each and a snack costs four thousand rupiah. What is the total? Seventeen thousand rupiah

cards.front: Hana saves Rp 15.000 a week. How many weeks to save Rp 90.000?
cards.say: Hana saves fifteen thousand rupiah a week. How many weeks to save ninety thousand rupiah? Six weeks. Ninety thousand divided by fifteen thousand equals six.
